prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for collectible letters in a mobile fantasy puzzle game. Reference image is ONLY a style reference: use design NUMBER 02 in the TOP MIDDLE cell of the attached board, and ignore all eleven other designs. Match its pale bright golden-yellow solid faces, very heavy friendly rounded SANS-SERIF capitals, narrow dark bronze edge and shallow soft bevel. Clean broad stems, open counters, no serifs, no dark enamel inset, no ornament, no engraving, no extra objects, no tile backgrounds, no glows. High readability at 16 pixels is the priority. Flat front-on view, upright, no perspective or tilt.
Create ONE SQUARE transparent image arranged as EXACTLY FIVE COLUMNS by FIVE ROWS of equal SQUARE CELLS. Invisible cell grid; no grid lines or borders. Each letter centered within its own cell. All letters have the same cap height, stroke weight and baseline; narrow I remains narrow instead of stretching. Glyphs occupy about 76% of cell height with ample transparent gutters. Exact placement:
Row 1: A C D E H
Row 2: I K L M N
Row 3: O P R T U
Row 4: V Y [empty] [empty] [empty]
Row 5: [empty] [empty] [empty] [empty] [empty]
Exactly SEVENTEEN letters in this exact order. Uppercase meaningful game letters only. No additional alphabet characters, duplicates, captions, index numbers or labels. Empty cells must remain completely transparent. Make P versus R, I versus L, M versus N instantly distinguishable. Each glyph fully contained in its equal square cell and not touching a neighboring cell. True transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no shadow on a floor, no sparkles, no watermark. Each letter is a solid gold collectible object silhouette. Bright gold dominates the full face; bronze appears only as a narrow outside contour. Do not reproduce the comparison board or any of its text.
